claim: An autonomous agent can set new state-of-the-art across mathematics and kernel engineering tasks and rank first on a machine learning benchmark subset.
falsifier: One could apply the same agent to a different set of metric-driven research tasks and measure whether it achieves state-of-the-art.

conditions: the tasks are metric-driven research tasks in mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning
the comparison is against previous best AI and human results
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific tasks, benchmarks, and agent configuration reported; transfer beyond them is unestablished.
